name: Keeper
description_en:
Keeper Password Manager stores login records and other sensitive items in a private vault, with supported browser, desktop and mobile clients. Personal, Family and business offerings differ; KeeperPAM, Secrets Manager and connection tools are adjacent products rather than automatically included password-manager features.

A useful pilot covers record creation, import fidelity, sharing permissions and recovery. Encryption and protection statements on the vendor site are design claims; this profile is not a security audit or proof that a particular deployment prevents compromise.
description_zh:
Keeper Password Manager 在私人保险库保存登录记录等敏感项目，并提供受支持的浏览器、桌面和移动客户端。个人、家庭及商业方案不同，KeeperPAM、Secrets Manager 和连接工具属于相邻产品，不能默认计入密码管理套餐。

有效试点应覆盖创建记录、导入保真、共享权限及恢复。官网的加密与保护说明属于设计主张，本文不是安全审计，也不证明特定部署能防止账户被攻陷。

sections.title_en: Map fields before confirming an import
sections.en:
The web-vault guide walks through creating a record with a type, title, login, password and website address. Import can come from browsers, another manager or a text file. The mapping screen lets the user correct column meanings, then a preview checks records and folder structure before confirmation. The guide recommends JSON for structured transfers rather than assuming CSV preserves everything.

For a pilot, import two disposable entries with a URL and custom field, compare them with the source, then verify the intended client’s fill behavior. A record shortcut can appear in multiple locations while edits affect the same record; it is not an independent backup. Plaintext export files require separate handling after migration.
sections.zh:
网页保险库指南说明按类型、标题、登录名、密码及网址创建记录，可从浏览器、其他管理器或文本文件导入。映射界面允许更正列含义，确认前预览记录及文件夹结构。指南建议结构化迁移用 JSON，不能假定 CSV 保留全部内容。

试点可导入两条包含网址、自定义字段的可丢弃记录，与原始内容比较，再核对目标客户端填充。记录快捷方式可出现在多个位置，但编辑影响同一记录，并非独立备份。迁移后的明文导出文件需另行处理。

sections.title_en: Save recovery material before losing access
sections.title_zh: 失去访问前保管恢复材料
sections.en:
Keeper’s current recovery article describes a randomly generated 24-word phrase. It is shown during setup, cannot be customized and does not replace the daily master password. Keeper says employees cannot retrieve it; losing both the master password and phrase can make encrypted data unrecoverable.

Keep the words in exact order in a secure location outside the vault. Enterprise SSO users follow a different account creation and device approval path from the personal master-password workflow. Validate the applicable organization policy rather than generalizing a consumer recovery article to every enterprise configuration.
sections.zh:
Keeper 当前恢复文章描述随机生成的 24 个单词恢复短语，仅在设置时显示，不能自定义，也不替代日常主密码。Keeper 表示员工无法取回短语，同时丢失主密码和短语可能导致加密数据无法恢复。

应按准确顺序在保险库外安全保管。企业 SSO 用户的账户创建及设备批准流程与个人主密码模式不同，需核对组织政策，不能将消费级恢复文章泛化为所有企业配置。

sections.title_zh: 家庭成员仍各有保险库
sections.en:
The personal pricing page describes five private vaults and 10 GB file storage for Family. Shared folders let members collaborate without granting access to every private record. Its FAQ distinguishes record sharing with permissions from a time-limited One-Time Share link. Test the recipient’s actual rights and expiration with non-sensitive content.

The retrieved pricing page left monetary fields blank or marked XXX. No current numeric tariff is asserted here; annual billing, a 30-day trial and paid add-ons are documented. BreachWatch and additional storage can affect the bill. Family, business and self-managed product terms need separate checks, and no source license was inspected.
sections.zh:
个人价格页说明 Family 提供五个私人保险库及 10 GB 文件存储。共享文件夹允许成员协作，但不授予全部私人记录的访问。FAQ 区分带权限的记录共享与限时 One-Time Share 链接。应使用非敏感内容测试接收者实际权限及过期。

读取的价格页金额为空或显示 XXX，因此本文不声明当前数字价格；年付、30 天试用及付费附加项已有文档。BreachWatch 和额外存储可能改变账单。家庭、商业、自管理产品条款需分别核对，本文未查源码许可。
